decision_scope: Only the 21 exact JusticeDAO releases and revisions named by JDAO-PINSET-1. This decision does not decide rights for a later release revision.

permanent_no_go.applies_to: training, fine-tuning, and any other learned use of these source rows
permanent_no_go.reason: No cited release establishes both an authoritative upstream source-rights grant and authority to create or use the retained transformations. Dataset-card declarations, public visibility, and an exact revision match are not legal authority. The immutable pinset is therefore permanently ineligible for learned training.
permanent_no_go.supersession_rule: Only a new exact release revision with a cited, authoritative upstream source-rights grant, transformation-rights grant, complete lineage, and a new rights review may be considered by a future task; it cannot change this pinset decision.
